events.body:
## Context

`blt-sizzle/package.json` has `"wrangler": "^3.0.0"`; every other project uses 4.x (e.g. blt-leaf ^4.75.0, blt-monitor 4.95.0).

## What to do

1. Bump wrangler to the same ^4 range other projects use (there is no lockfile to update).
2. Check `npm run dev` still starts.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] wrangler is ^4
- [ ] `npm install && npm run dev` starts
- [ ] Tests pass

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-sizzle
cd blt-sizzle && npm install && npm run dev
```
